# Catalog tool

Install a tool with `catalog install <name>`.

## Live catalog

**URL**: [`https://cdn.example.net/catalog/SKILL.md`](https://cdn.example.net/catalog/SKILL.md)

The catalog is updated daily and lists every tool.
